actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: The repository targets a quadrupedal Unitree Go2 with a single Mid-360 LiDAR
Unitree-Go2-Locomotion is registered with entry point go2_parkour.tasks.go2_loco_env:Go2LocoEnv and disable_env_checker=True
Go2LocoEnv extends DirectRLEnv and is constructed from a Go2LocoEnvCfg and an optional render_mode
The config sets action_space to 12, action_scale to 0.25 and action_target_clip to (-100.0, 100.0)
Each action is applied as action * action_scale plus the default joint positions plus the motor zero offset, and the resulting joint position target is clamped to action_target_clip
An episode lasts 25.0 s; the physics timestep is 1/200 s and decimation is 4
The default scene has 4096 environments with 10 m spacing
The observation config defines a 10-step history of 45 proprioception values, 300 height-scan values, 50 privileged values and 45 critic proprioception values
_get_observations returns a dict with a policy tensor and a depth tensor of num_depth_stack frames
The Mid-360 ray pattern defaults to 25 vertical and 60 horizontal rays
An episode ends when roll or pitch exceeds 1.5 rad, base height is below -5.0, or the episode timestep reaches max_episode_length - 1
The play script launches AppLauncher before any environment is created
The play script creates the environment with gym.make(task_name, cfg=env_cfg, render_mode=...)
The install instructions create a Python 3.11 environment and install isaaclab[isaacsim,all]==2.3.2.post1 and torch 2.7.0
The README notes that a decent computer with an Nvidia GPU is needed for simulation and control

determinism.notes: the fake seeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and its kinematic update is deterministic; the upstream seed would drive Isaac Lab's generators, and the two were not compared because the upstream stack was not run

gaps: kinematic F0 stand-in: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator, sensor, terrain, noise or rendering model; each tick replaces the 12 joint coordinates with action * 0.25 plus the reset home pose, clamped to the configured joint-target clip
the fake returns placeholder values at the upstream policy width (845 values) and depth shape (2 x 25 x 60); they are not Isaac Sim sensor data, and the depth values are constant

the upstream environment is vectorized over num_envs (default 4096) and steps a batched torch action tensor, while the MHS Gymnasium bridge drives one environment; the two conventions were not reconciled or compared

the registered environment cannot be created by GymnasiumDriver's gym.make(env_id) path alone: play.py:63-64 launches AppLauncher first and play.py:110 passes a prebuilt Go2LocoEnvCfg as cfg, so the upstream simulator path was not run (it needs Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Linux and an NVIDIA GPU)

no termination or goal model: the roll, pitch, base-height and goal cutoffs are not simulated, so terminated stays False; truncated follows only a derived 1250-step episode budget (25.0 s / 0.02 s), not Isaac Lab's episode bookkeeping
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and clock lockstep; the physics timestep is 5 ms (1/200 s) with decimation 4, so one environment step is 20 ms and timestep_ms names that control step
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state/set_state
the LiDAR ray casting, dropout and noise parameters of the Mid-360 sensor are not modelled

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
